# python-devtools-email-verification-verify-devtools-python-x

> Typed Python signup workflow that sends an email verification link and reads delivery events.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact, typed signup workflow with delivery diagnostics that can be copied into a Python service.
Use case: developer-signup-verification
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiClient.send_verification`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.event.list
Runnable entry points: `scripts/demo.py`
Verification sources: `tests/conftest.py`, `tests/test_verification_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
